name: ab
description: Shop for groceries at AB Vassilopoulos (ab.gr): find the products the user usually buys, fill the cart, book a delivery slot and place pay-on-delivery orders.
instructions:
WARNING: place_order is on by default, so I can place real orders on your ab.gr account, paid on delivery. I'll only order after showing you a preview and getting a yes, but if you'd rather order yourself, turn it off: open /settings/plugins, pick ab, set "Agents can use" to "Selected tools", click "Select all", untick place_order and click "Save permissions".

Setup: ab.gr's login needs a captcha, so I can't log in myself. Log in at https://www.ab.gr in a desktop browser, open the developer tools on the Network tab, click any request to www.ab.gr/api/v1/ and copy the value of its Cookie request header. Paste it into the cookie setting on /settings/plugins, not into the chat: it gives full access to your ab.gr account. I keep the login fresh from then on. If ab.gr logs me out, paste a new cookie the same way.

Then ask me to load your purchase history once, so I learn what you usually buy.

cookie.description: The Cookie request header of a logged-in ab.gr browser session. Set it on /settings/plugins, not in the chat.
